gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints enterprise columns Landfill Fund, Electric Fund, Combined System Utilities Fund (Internal Service Funds column not used); detail has no business-type lines. The JSON receipts are total operating revenues 80,528,182 + interest income 2,504,535 + participation and capacity agreements 1,308,605 + net coal sales 923,380 + grant revenue 329,051 + miscellaneous income 1,331,399 = 86,925,152 (this year the loss on disposal is in business_type.other_financing, not receipts). Landfill 2,661,319 + 7,625 + 493,169 + 50,156 = 3,212,269; Electric 52,478,980 + 1,397,250 + 1,308,605 + 923,380 + 839,035 = 56,947,250; Combined System Utilities 25,380,258 + 614,116 + 278,895 + 492,364 = 26,765,633. 3,212,269 + 56,947,250 + 26,765,633 = 86,925,152 = gap. The governmental revenue/expenditure gaps were explained by the first pass (different basis) and are not repeated.
